Package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.cache

Interface Cache

All Superinterfaces:
org.teavm.jso.JSObject
public interface Cache extends org.teavm.jso.JSObject
A Workers cache, from Caches.defaultCache() or Caches.open(String).

Entries are keyed by request URL and only a GET request can be a key. The cache is local to the data center the Worker ran in, so an entry put in one location is not there in another. A response is stored when it is cacheable by its Cache-Control header; the platform decides, and put returns either way.

The blocking methods wait for the platform. The *Async forms return the promise, for ctx.waitUntil when a response should not wait on the write. 

 Cache cache = Caches.defaultCache();
 Response hit = cache.match(request);
 if (hit == null) cache.put(request, response.copy());
Since:
1.0.3
